stem:
From his terrace at about midnight, Tushar sees the Moon as a bright full circle high in the sky.

Where is the Moon relative to the Sun as seen from Earth?

options.text: The Moon is nearly opposite the Sun.
The Moon is in nearly the same direction as the Sun.
The Moon lies between Earth and the Sun.
Full Moon happens at any Moon-Sun separation, so position does not matter.

teacher.key_rationale: A full Moon high at midnight is nearly opposite the Sun as seen from Earth.
